evals.name: supply-good
evals.prompt: 用 fulfillment-card 渲染夹具 supply-good.json：合格纯供应采购包，含 3 个中英付款节点、请款附件与计划时间区间。
evals.expected_output: 标准履约卡片：供应商作主标题、付款表格、页脚数据来源；无变更章节；内容质量（中英、比例 100%、含税）均达标。
assertions: claim link points to 请款申请.html
non-GC hides 约束条款 section
total_amount marks 含税 or 不含税
each payment node has attachments after enrich
no quality warnings when data is good

evals.name: gc-constraint
evals.prompt: 渲染夹具 gc-constraint.json：总包卡片，constraint_clauses 非空。
evals.expected_output: 出现「约束条款」章节且正文含约束文字；付款表仍规范。
assertions: GC shows 约束条款 section
total_amount marks 含税 or 不含税
each payment node has attachments after enrich
no quality warnings when data is good

evals.name: non-gc-hides-constraint
evals.prompt: 渲染夹具 non-gc-hides-constraint.json：纯供应，但 card-data 里写了 constraint_clauses。
evals.expected_output: HTML 不得出现「约束条款」章节（非总包隐藏）。
assertions: non-GC hides 约束条款 section
total_amount marks 含税 or 不含税
no quality warnings when data is good

evals.name: attachments-infer
evals.prompt: 渲染夹具 attachments-infer.json：付款节点未手写 payment_attachments。
evals.expected_output: enrich 后每个节点有请款附件，且出现在付款表中。
assertions: each payment node has attachments after enrich
total_amount marks 含税 or 不含税
no quality warnings when data is good

evals.name: no-change-on-card
evals.prompt: 渲染夹具 change-items.json：card-data 里仍有旧 change_items，确认卡片不再展示变更章节。
evals.expected_output: HTML 无「变更内容」/ change-table；变更只看 Change Log。
assertions: no quality warnings when data is good

evals.name: quality-gap
evals.prompt: 渲染夹具 quality-gap.json：故意残缺（空供应商、无中英节点名、比例合计非 100%、金额无含税标注）。系统仍应出卡，但必须识别并提示数据质量问题。
evals.expected_output: 仍能出卡（format 过）；quality_ok=false；card-data 写入 quality_warnings；卡片显示「数据质量提醒」横幅。
assertions: quality_ok is false when data is poor
quality warnings recorded when data is poor
quality banner visible when warnings present
quality banner sits above card header
